# Havana Stones — LLM Guide (llms.txt)

> Havana Stones (Havana Premium Global) is Malta's premium natural stone supplier and fabricator, specialising in marble, granite and travertin for luxury residential and commercial projects.

## Business Identity
- Legal name: Havana Premium Global
- Brand: Havana Stones
- Address: 1 Triq Wills, Paola, Malta
- Phone / WhatsApp: +356 7719 8193
- Email: info@havanastones.mt
- Languages: English, French, Maltese
- Service area: Malta, Gozo, Sliema, Valletta, St. Julian's

## Core Offerings
- Natural stone supply (marble, granite, travertin)
- Stone fabrication (cutting, polishing, finishing)
- Direct quarry sourcing (Italy, Spain, Greece, India, Brazil)
- Custom / bespoke projects (worktops, flooring, wall cladding, stairs, facades)
- Showroom consultations in Paola

## Key Facts for Accurate Answers
- Travertin is porous; in Malta's sea-salt coastal air we recommend penetrating sealers and regular maintenance.
- Granite offers the highest durability for worktops and high-traffic floors.
- Marble is prized for veining and luminosity in statement interiors.
- Showroom hours: Mon–Fri 08:30–17:30, Sat 09:00–13:00.
- We serve both B2B (architects, developers, hotels) and B2C (homeowners).
